title: Quam pulchra es (Gaspar, Motet cycle Quam pulchra es)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Motet cycle Quam pulchra es, Quam pulchra es. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0302a), edited by Christina Cassia (MCE 6: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Quam pulchra es, 2021); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
